studio.conflict: The project changed. Your edit was not applied. Review the latest revision and try again.
studio.invalidProject: The host returned an invalid project.
studio.applied: Edit saved. Source assets are preserved.
studio.opened: Project reopened. Every accepted edit is saved by the host.
studio.title: Video Studio
studio.welcomeHint: Import media or generate footage, then assemble an editable timeline.
studio.connection: Connection interrupted. Project and jobs remain on the host. {error}
studio.libraryEmpty: Your imported media and generated takes appear here.
studio.createDescription: Create a local project, import footage, and build a timeline. Editing works without an AI model.
studio.imported: Media imported. Add it to any compatible track.
studio.localOnly: Studio imports only media served by this host. Remote URLs are not fetched.
studio.chatImported: Chat media is available in this project’s asset library.
studio.importUnsupported: Import probing is unavailable on this host.
studio.assetHint: Drag assets to a track, or use Add. Removing a clip preserves its source.
studio.noAssets: Import video, images, or audio to begin.
studio.vfr: Variable frame rate: output sampled by timestamps.
studio.missing: Source media missing. Relink the original file to preserve timeline references.
studio.relinked: Original media restored. The host verified its content hash.
studio.playbackError: This browser could not decode the media. Download the rendered output or try a compatible browser.
studio.previewEmpty: Build a timeline, then render its preview. Preview and export use the same composition.
studio.sourcePreview: Source preview · timeline effects are not shown here.
studio.renderUnsupported: Local rendering is unavailable on this host.
studio.renderQueued: Render queued against the current project revision. You can continue editing.
studio.emptyTimeline: Add video or audio tracks, then place media from the library.
studio.dragStale: The project changed during the drag. Review and move the clip again.
studio.splitInside: Place the playhead inside the selected clip before splitting.
studio.frameHint: All edit values are integer project frames. Drag a clip to move it; drag its edges to trim.
studio.linked: Apply timing edits to linked clips
studio.selectHint: Select a clip on the timeline to edit its timing, sound, or framing.
studio.compositionOrder: Tracks compose in list order, bottom layer first. Fades affect picture and sound. Timeline audio is mixed at export.
studio.captionUnavailable: Caption rendering is unavailable on this host.
studio.transcriptionUnavailable: Automatic transcription and word-based cuts are not yet available in Studio. Captions remain manually editable.
studio.notLoaded: Load this model in the host before generating.
studio.samplingRecipe: {name} fixes the sampling: exactly {steps} steps on its own schedule.
studio.samplingRecipeChanged: This take was sampled with {previous}; the loaded model samples differently, so its steps start from the model default ({steps}).
studio.noModes: This checkpoint advertises no generation mode that Studio can run.
studio.guideRequired: Add at least one timed image keyframe.
studio.referenceRequired: Select at least one reference image.
studio.referenceFrames: Reference generation with this model needs at least {frames} output frames.
studio.keyframesHelp: Each image guides a specific output frame. This is separate from identity references.
studio.keyframeLimit: At most 16 temporal image guides can be submitted.
studio.referenceLimit: This model accepts at most {count} reference images.
studio.generationQueued: Generation queued. The finished take will appear in the library.
studio.contextChanged: The project changed while preparing the assistant. Review your selection and send again.
studio.sessionUnavailable: The host could not create a dedicated Studio chat session.
studio.projectChanged: The active project changed. The assistant request was not sent.
studio.agentExample: Trim the selected clip to its first four seconds.
studio.assistantPersistence: TensorAgent uses its saved conversation store. Other hosts retain up to eight recent messages in this browser; project packages exclude chat history.
studio.proposalApplied: Proposal applied and saved as one undoable transaction.
studio.shotStarted: Generation started. Track its result in Jobs.
studio.shotNeedsModel: No video model is loaded. The plan is saved for later.
studio.plannedShotQueued: The planned shot is queued. Its requested settings were validated without automatic quality reduction.
studio.streamUnavailable: The host did not provide an assistant response stream.
studio.responseTooLarge: Assistant response exceeded the bounded context limit.
studio.agentStopped: Assistant stopped. Any saved proposal remains available for review.
studio.jobPersistence: Jobs belong to the host. Closing this panel does not cancel them. Interrupted work is reported after restart.
studio.noJobs: No generation or render jobs yet.
studio.stageImporting: Adding the take to the library
studio.jobPreviousRun: Last run with these settings took {time}
studio.jobRemainingDenoise: About {time} of denoising left, then decoding
studio.jobRemainingDenoiseSoon: Under a minute of denoising left, then decoding
studio.jobEstimatePending: Time left appears after the first step
studio.interrupted: Restart the operation from its settings. Mid-generation checkpoint recovery is unavailable.
studio.previewStale: Preview is from revision {revision}. Render again to see your latest edits.
studio.dissolveHelp: The overlap becomes a picture and audio dissolve. Clip positions stay fixed. Fade controls remain editable.
studio.deleteAssetUsed: This asset is used by {count} timeline clip(s). Deleting it will also remove those clips. Other assets and their clips will stay.
studio.deleteAssetUnused: This asset is not used on the timeline. It will be removed from this project’s library.
studio.deleteAssetRetention: You can Undo this change. Original files and managed media are retained for Undo and existing jobs; this does not free disk space.
studio.deleteAssetChanged: The project changed while you reviewed deletion. Nothing was deleted. Review the asset and try again.
studio.assetDeleted: Asset removed from the library. Use Undo to restore it and any removed clips. Source files are preserved.
studio.removeTrackUsed: This track holds {count} clip(s). Removing it also removes those clips. Clips on other tracks stay.
studio.removeTrackRetention: You can Undo this change. Assets stay in the library.
studio.removeTrackChanged: The project changed while you reviewed removal. Nothing was removed. Review the track and try again.
studio.trackRemoved: Track removed. Use Undo to restore it and any clips it held. Source assets stay in the library.
studio.reloadHint: Read the project again from the host.
studio.capabilitiesUnknown: Studio could not read this host’s capabilities.
studio.importUnavailable: Importing media isn’t available on this host: {reason}
studio.replaceSelected: Replace the selected clip with this
studio.guideMaking: A take is being made. It appears in the library when it is ready.
studio.guideAddText: Import video, photos or music, or generate a new take from a description.
studio.guideArrangeText: Press Add to timeline on a library item, or drag it onto a track.
studio.guideExportText: Render a preview to watch your edit, then export an MP4.
studio.replaceHint: To swap this clip for another take while keeping its place, open More on that library item and choose Replace the selected clip with this. The original stays in the library.
studio.slotUnsupported: The loaded model can’t use a photo here.
studio.lengthRaised: Length raised to {seconds} s: this model needs at least that for reference photos.
studio.firstPhotoRequired: Choose the photo this take starts on: this model always starts on one.
studio.refuseMode: The loaded model can’t make this kind of shot.
studio.refuseLength: This model can’t make a take of that length.
studio.refuseSize: This model can’t make a take of that size.
studio.refuseSampling: This model needs other sampling settings. Reset to model defaults, then try again.
studio.refusePhotos: The loaded model can’t use these photos this way.
studio.refuseInputs: These photos don’t fit this kind of shot.
studio.refuseModelChanged: The video model changed. Studio re-read its settings: check them and generate again.
studio.refuseNegative: This model doesn’t use a negative prompt at this guidance. Clear it under Advanced.
studio.refuseQueue: Too many takes are waiting. Try again when one finishes.
studio.refusePhotoFormat: This photo format isn’t supported. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
studio.refuseRecipe: The loaded model now samples differently. Studio re-read its settings: review the steps and generate again.
studio.refuseMedia: This host can’t make video right now.
studio.canStartEnd: start and/or end on a photo
studio.canReferences: keep a person or object from reference photos
studio.modelNeedsPhoto: Always starts on a photo you choose.
studio.modelCan: Makes takes from a description, and can {list}.
studio.placeholderRef: The person from Picture 1 walks through a night market, lanterns overhead
studio.placeholderKeyframes: What happens between the photos, and how the camera moves
studio.placeholderBoth: What happens between the two photos
studio.placeholderLast: What happens before the take lands on the last photo
studio.placeholderFirst: What moves in the photo, and how the camera moves
studio.placeholderText: A slow pan over waves at sunrise, warm light
studio.notAPhoto: That file was imported, but it isn’t a still photo.
studio.generateIntro: The loaded video model makes it on this host. Finished takes appear in the library.
studio.generationGated: Video generation isn’t available on this host.
studio.noVideoModelHelp: To make takes, go back to chat and choose a video model (MiniMax-H3, LTX 2.5 or Wan) in the model menu, then come back: Studio notices it by itself. To end a take on a photo, choose MiniMax-H3 or LTX 2.5.
studio.shotKept: Your description and photos are kept.
studio.choosePhotoFirst: Choose photo for the first frame
studio.choosePhotoLast: Choose photo for the last frame
studio.slotCropped: Edges outside the take’s frame are cut off.
studio.noPhotos: No photos in this project yet. Import one to use it here.
studio.noPhotosNoImport: This project has no photos, and importing isn’t available on this host.
studio.framesRequiredTitle: Start from a photo (required for this model)
studio.framesTitle: Start or end on a photo (optional)
studio.framesHelp: Skip this to make the take from your description alone.
studio.resultNeedsFirst: Choose the photo this take starts on.
studio.resultBoth: The take goes from the first frame to the last frame.
studio.resultLast: The take ends on the last frame.
studio.resultFirst: The take starts on the first frame and brings it to life.
studio.resultNone: No photos: the take is made from your description alone.
studio.referencesHelp2: Your photos show who or what to include; the take does not start or end on them. Choose up to {count}.
studio.useFrames: Start or end the take on a photo
studio.useFramesHelp: The take begins on your first photo, ends on your last, or both.
studio.useKeyframesHelp: Each photo appears at the moment you choose.
studio.useReferences: Keep someone or something the same
studio.useReferencesHelp: Your photos show who or what to include in a new scene; the take does not start or end on them.
studio.useSwitchedKept: {use}. Photos chosen for the other ways are kept for when you switch back.
studio.sizeFromPhotoHint: {width} × {height}, matched to {name}: faces and hands keep their detail. About {ratio}× the work per frame of the {baseWidth} × {baseHeight} default.
studio.sizeFromPhotoUnknown: The host sizes the take from {name}.
studio.resetDone: Length, size and sampling are back to the model’s defaults.
studio.resetHint: Re-reads the loaded model, then puts length, size, frame rate, steps, guidance and sound back to its defaults. Your description, photos and seed stay.
studio.assistantIntro: Ask in plain words. The assistant reads this project and suggests edits you review, then apply in one step (one Undo reverts them all). It can also plan shots to generate later, and start an export.
studio.assistantNeedsChat: The assistant needs a chat model, and a video model is loaded right now.
studio.assistantNeedsChatHelp: Go back to chat, choose a chat model, then come back. Your project stays as it is.
studio.assistantModelHint: Works with chat models that can edit projects (tool calling). If it replies without suggesting changes, try another chat model.
studio.assistantNoSelection: Nothing selected: the assistant looks at the whole timeline.
studio.exampleTrim: Trim the selected clip to its first 2 seconds
studio.exampleFade: Fade out the last clip over 1 second
studio.exampleTitle: Add the title “Day one” over the first 3 seconds
studio.examplePlan: Plan a 5-second opening shot of waves at sunrise
studio.exampleExport: Export the timeline as an MP4
studio.proposalUndo: {count} change(s) · one Undo reverts all of them
studio.staleProposal2: You changed the timeline after this was suggested, so it can’t be applied as is.
studio.plannedShotsHelp2: Saved plans, not footage. Load a video model to make them: Studio notices it by itself. Open one in Generate to review it first.
studio.recipeLoaded: {name} is now loaded, so the steps follow it ({steps}).
studio.recipeRemoved: {previous} is no longer loaded, so the steps start from the model default ({steps}).
studio.lengthShortLast: {name} is trained on {min}–{max} s clips. At {seconds} s a take has little time to reach its last photo and often cuts or dissolves to it.
studio.lengthShort: {name} is trained on {min}–{max} s clips; a {seconds} s take is a quick preview.
studio.lengthLong: {name} is trained on {min}–{max} s clips; longer takes may lose coherence.
studio.lastFrameTip: Describe how the scene arrives at the last photo. A photo unlike the scene is usually reached by a cut or dissolve rather than a move.
studio.invalidGuides2: Each keyframe needs a photo, an output frame within the take, and a strength above 0 and at most 1.
